response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software craftsmanship, architectural design skills, and proven ability to work on complex systems, he lacks the fundamental technical requirements for this role. His Java experience is minimal and last used in 2018 at Altom for unspecified robotic and orchestration projects. Most critically, there is no evidence of Spring ecosystem experience, Kotlin knowledge, or recent enterprise framework expertise—all core requirements. His career trajectory has moved toward JavaScript/TypeScript full-stack development and AI infrastructure rather than JVM specialization, making him fundamentally misaligned despite his seniority level.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship background with demonstrated expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and architectural design principles
Proven ability to build and maintain complex, large-scale systems including distributed infrastructure and microservices at scale
Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing skills demonstrated through conference talks, technical workshops, and mentoring roles
concerns: Minimal and outdated Java experience (last used ~2018); no Kotlin expertise despite both being core requirements for the role
Complete absence of Spring ecosystem or enterprise framework experience, which are explicitly required qualifications
Recent career focus on JavaScript/TypeScript full-stack development and AI-agent infrastructure diverges significantly from JVM and IDE tooling specialization
